description: This file defines the QwenCodeHandler class, which extends BaseProvider and implements SingleCompletionHandler. It manages OAuth authentication with Qwen AI, handles token refresh, and provides methods for creating chat message streams and prompt completions using the OpenAI API client, customized for Qwen AI integration.

classes.name: QwenCodeHandler
classes.description: A class that manages OAuth authentication with Qwen AI, handles token refresh, and facilitates chat message streaming and prompt completion using the OpenAI API client tailored for Qwen AI.

methods.name: ensureClient
methods.description: Creates or returns the existing OpenAI client instance.

methods.name: loadCachedQwenCredentials
methods.description: Loads OAuth credentials from cache file.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth access token, ensuring only one refresh occurs at a time.

methods.name: doRefreshAccessToken
methods.description: Performs the actual token refresh via HTTP request.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the current OAuth token is still valid based on expiry.

methods.name: ensureAuthenticated
methods.description: Ensures OAuth credentials are loaded and valid, refreshing if necessary.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for API requests based on credentials.

methods.name: callApiWithRetry
methods.description: Calls an API function with automatic token refresh on 401 errors.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat message response, handling token, model, and tool integrations.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model ID and info used for chat completions.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt for completion and returns the generated text.
